title: Decide idle compaction for worker sessions
notes: From docs/research/claude-releases-2026-09-27-to-11-27.md. Claude Code 2.1.299 compacts an idle conversation over 200K tokens after about 54 minutes; "idleCompaction": false turns it off. A paused worker waiting on CI or a review loop can come back compacted, losing detail mid-task. Do: confirm the setting in the docs; then set idleCompaction false for worker sessions through appSessionSettings (src/main/workers/dispatch.ts, as workers-decision-12 did for denyInsteadOfPrompting), leaving main's as Claude Code's default. Test beside dispatch.test.ts; one line in the workers decision.
